from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs/task-6567adcf.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    """Reduce each framed panel to 1 iff it has exactly two marked cells."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Grid lines are full rows/columns of a single color.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def intervals(size, separators):
        groups = []
        start = 0
        for s in separators:
            if start < s:
                groups.append((start, s))
            start = s + 1
        if start < size:
            groups.append((start, size))
        return groups

    row_groups = intervals(h, sep_rows)
    col_groups = intervals(w, sep_cols)
    # Background is the most common non-separator color; the marker is the
    # other non-separator color in these panels.
    sep_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in sep_colors)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker_colors = [v for v in counts if v != background]
    marker = marker_colors[0] if marker_colors else None
    return [
        [1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)) == 2 else background
         for c0, c1 in col_groups]
        for r0, r1 in row_groups
    ]
'''
